root.name: Commerce
root.description: Commerce analytics domain for the Shopify-centered modern data platform. It is the parent governance domain; consumer-facing datasets are assigned to one leaf domain when a more specific business process exists.

subdomains.name: Order & Sales
subdomains.description: Orders, order items, sales amounts, discounts, and order-cohort analysis.

subdomains.name: Payments
subdomains.description: Payment authorization, collection, refund transactions, and payment status analysis.

subdomains.name: Refunds
subdomains.description: Refund events, refunded items, sales reversals, and refund analysis.

subdomains.name: Fulfillment
subdomains.description: Fulfillment, shipment, delivery, and fulfillment-event analysis.

subdomains.name: Commerce Reference
subdomains.description: Shared reference entities such as Stores and Items used across commerce processes.

groups.purpose: Business ownership for commerce concepts, metrics, and consumer-facing analytical assets.
Technical ownership and stewardship for ingestion, lakehouse, dbt, orchestration, metadata, and governed agent infrastructure.

tags.description: Technical discovery label for metadata originating from Shopify.
Asset participates in the dbt / MetricFlow semantic graph.
Asset follows the business-key plus record-hash versioning contract.
Asset participates in the daily execution responsibility model.

commerce-entity-store.name: Store
commerce-entity-store.description: A customer store or merchant location used as a commerce analysis entity.

commerce-entity-item.name: Item
commerce-entity-item.description: A sellable merchandise item used as the canonical product analysis entity.

commerce-entity-order.name: Order
commerce-entity-order.description: A Shopify order representing a customer purchase transaction context.

commerce-entity-order-item.name: Order Item
commerce-entity-order-item.description: A line item within an order and the core grain for item-level sales analysis.

commerce-entity-payment-transaction.name: Payment Transaction
commerce-entity-payment-transaction.description: A Shopify payment transaction such as authorization, capture, sale, or refund.

commerce-entity-refund.name: Refund
commerce-entity-refund.description: A refund business record associated with an order.

commerce-entity-refund-item.name: Refund Item
commerce-entity-refund-item.description: An item-level refund record used to attribute sales reversals to merchandise.

commerce-entity-fulfillment.name: Fulfillment
commerce-entity-fulfillment.description: A shipment or fulfillment record associated with an order.

commerce-entity-fulfillment-item.name: Fulfillment Item
commerce-entity-fulfillment-item.description: An item-level quantity associated with a fulfillment.

commerce-entity-fulfillment-event.name: Fulfillment Event
commerce-entity-fulfillment-event.description: A timestamped lifecycle event emitted for a fulfillment or shipment.

commerce-metric-order-count.name: Order Count
commerce-metric-order-count.description: Distinct number of orders in the requested analytical context.

commerce-metric-gross-sales.name: Gross Sales
commerce-metric-gross-sales.description: Gross item sales amount before sales reversals.

commerce-metric-discount-amount.name: Discount Amount
commerce-metric-discount-amount.description: Discount amount allocated to ordered merchandise.

commerce-metric-sales-before-reversal.name: Sales Before Reversal
commerce-metric-sales-before-reversal.description: Sales value after discount logic but before refund-driven sales reversals.

commerce-metric-collected-payment-amount.name: Collected Payment Amount
commerce-metric-collected-payment-amount.description: Successfully collected payment amount in the selected payment-time context.

commerce-metric-refund-processed-amount.name: Refund Processed Amount
commerce-metric-refund-processed-amount.description: Amount represented by successfully processed refund business records.

commerce-metric-sales-reversal-amount.name: Sales Reversal Amount
commerce-metric-sales-reversal-amount.description: Merchandise sales amount reversed by item-level refunds.

commerce-metric-shipment-count.name: Shipment Count
commerce-metric-shipment-count.description: Number of fulfillment shipments entering the shipped or in-transit state.

commerce-metric-delivery-count.name: Delivery Count
commerce-metric-delivery-count.description: Number of fulfillments reaching the delivered state.

commerce-metric-average-time-to-ship.name: Average Time To Ship
commerce-metric-average-time-to-ship.description: Average elapsed minutes from order time to shipment or in-transit time.

commerce-metric-average-delivery-duratio.name: Average Delivery Duration
commerce-metric-average-delivery-duratio.description: Average elapsed minutes from shipment or in-transit time to delivery.

commerce-metric-average-order-value.name: Average Order Value
commerce-metric-average-order-value.description: Average order value using the governed sales-before-reversal and distinct-order semantics.

commerce-metric-activity-net-sales.name: Activity Net Sales
commerce-metric-activity-net-sales.description: Net sales viewed by the actual business activity times of sales and reversals.

commerce-metric-order-cohort-net-sales.name: Order Cohort Net Sales
commerce-metric-order-cohort-net-sales.description: Net sales attributed back to the original order cohort rather than the later reversal activity date.

data-time-business-time.name: Business Time
data-time-business-time.description: Time when the business event or state actually occurred.

data-time-source-updated-time.name: Source Updated Time
data-time-source-updated-time.description: Time when the source system states that the business object was last updated.

data-time-observation-time.name: Observation Time
data-time-observation-time.description: Time when the data platform observed or ingested the source representation.

data-model-business-version.name: Business Version
data-model-business-version.description: A distinct business-content version identified by business key plus content hash, independent of repeated observations.

data-model-current-state.name: Current State
data-model-current-state.description: The latest canonical business state selected from versioned source history for the required analytical context.

data-model-exact-partition-completeness.name: Exact Partition Completeness
data-model-exact-partition-completeness.description: Whether every required consumer asset for one exact execution partition has materialized successfully.

structured_properties.description: Governed handling classification for commerce datasets.

allowed_values.description: Internal business data with standard access controls.
Sensitive business data requiring tighter access controls.
Highly restricted data requiring explicit authorization.

structured_properties.description: Business impact tier used for governance, incident prioritization, and discovery.

allowed_values.description: Low business impact if stale or unavailable.
Useful analytical asset with moderate business impact.
Important consumer-facing asset supporting core commerce analysis.
Mission-critical asset with explicit operational obligations.

structured_properties.description: Governance state controlling how strongly an AI/Data Agent may rely on this dataset. Runtime verification is intentionally stronger than semantic readiness.

allowed_values.description: Discoverable context; not approved as a primary analytical answer source.
Modeled and semantically governed, but real Runtime evidence may still be deferred.
Semantic contract plus required real Runtime evidence has been verified.
Agent should not use this asset for analytical answers.
